nodes.title: Nonnegativity of the hypergeometric mass function

nodes.summary: The hypergeometric mass function vanishes above the number of marked items.
nodes.title: Hypergeometric mass vanishes above the number of marked items

nodes.summary: The hypergeometric mass function vanishes above the number of draws.
nodes.title: Hypergeometric mass vanishes above the number of draws

nodes.summary: The hypergeometric mass function: the probability `C(K, k) C(N - K, n - k) / C(N, n)` of drawing exactly `k` marked items in `n` draws without replacement from `N` items of which `K` are marked; it is `0` for `k > n`. The parameter domain is `K ≤ N`, `n ≤ N`; outside it the value is not a probability (`N - K` truncates, and `C(N, n) = 0` makes it `0` for `n > N`).
nodes.title: Hypergeometric mass function

nodes.summary: The hypergeometric law on `ℕ` with population size `N`, `K ≤ N` marked items, and `n ≤ N` draws without replacement.
nodes.title: Hypergeometric distribution

nodes.summary: For `K ≤ N` and `n ≤ N` the hypergeometric probabilities sum to one; this is Vandermonde's identity `∑ₖ C(K, k) C(N - K, n - k) = C(N, n)`.
nodes.title: Normalization

nodes.summary: For `0 < N`, `K ≤ N` and `n ≤ N` the hypergeometric law has mean `n K / N`.
nodes.title: Mean

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
